functions.notes: Allocates 8-byte wrapper on heap 0x65, zero-fills it, stores ov80_022384FC(bgConfig) at +4, returns wrapper. Field +0 left zero (unused or set elsewhere). Caller ov80_0222AEA0 (asm/overlay_80_0222ACA0.s:306) passes [r0+0] of its arg and stores the return.

functions.notes: Allocates 0xc bytes on heap 0x65, zero-fills, builds task struct. Pool literals: ov80_02238530, 0x0001368C. NOT in the .inc .public list, so declare it static; same for ov80_02238530, ov80_0223857C, ov80_022385C4.

functions.name: ov80_02238530

struct_accesses.meaning: frame counter: if <2 increment and return; else reset to 0
state flag toggled via eor #1 every 3rd frame

functions.notes: SysTaskFunc. Builds 2x2 u16 tilemap buffer on stack (sp+0xc, 8 bytes inside 0x14 frame) via ov80_0223857C(buf, (u8)state), then LoadRectToBgTilemapRect(bgConfig, 3, buf, 0xe, 2, 2, 2) and ScheduleBgTilemapBufferTransfer(bgConfig, 3). Blinking/animated 2x2 tile at (14,2) on BG 3. Caller-side u8 narrowing (lsl/lsr #0x18) of state before bl ov80_0223857C means that function takes u8.

functions.name: ov80_0223857C

struct_accesses.meaning: u16[4] (2x2 tilemap entries), buf[y*2+x] = 0x60 + y*0x10 + (state ? 0xe : 0xc) + x

functions.notes: Leaf, push {r4-r7}/bx lr, no lr saved. Pure nested loop y=0..1, x=0..1 writing tilemap entries; base tile 0x6c..0x7d or 0x6e..0x7f depending on state. Second param compared raw (cmp r1, #0) — callee does not narrow; caller narrows to u8, consistent with u8 param.

functions.notes: Destructor for the wrapper from ov80_022384D8. Exported; tail-called via bx from ov80_0222AEB0 (asm/overlay_80_0222ACA0.s:317) with arg [r1+0].

functions.name: ov80_022385C4
functions.notes: Destroys task then frees inner struct. Not in .public list — static.

functions.name: ov80_022385D8
functions.notes: Pure switch lookup with thumb ldrh jump table (7 entries). case 1->0x71, 2->0x73, 3->0x77, 4->0x87, 5->0x7b, 6->0x8f; case 0 and >6 return a0 unchanged (default falls to bx lr with r0 untouched). Write as switch(a0){case 1: return 0x71; ...} return a0; Callers (asm/overlay_80_02235900.s:522,591; asm/unk_02096910.s:186) pass a u8 loaded via ldrb without narrowing — so param is int/u32, not u8. Result fed to sub_0205C268(u32) and FrontierSave_GetStat(FrontierSave*, int, int) as the stat-id arg — values look like Battle Frontier stat IDs.

functions.name: ov80_02238610
functions.notes: Same shape as ov80_022385D8. case 1->0x64, 2->0x66, 3->0x68, 4->0x6c, 5->0x6a, 6->0x6e; case 0 and >6 return a0. Note non-monotonic mapping (case 4->0x6c, case 5->0x6a) — preserve exactly. Callers at asm/overlay_80_02235900.s:554,573.

risks: Two thumb ldrh jump-table switches (ov80_022385D8, ov80_02238610) — must be expressed as plain C switch so MWCC regenerates the table; case 0 and default both return the input argument
Four of the eight functions (ov80_022384FC, ov80_02238530, ov80_0223857C, ov80_022385C4) are not in the .inc .public list — make them static
eor-based toggle `state ^= 1` in ov80_02238530 — write as ^= 1, not !state, to get the eor instruction

ov80_0223857C value computation uses running accumulators (base 0x60 advanced by 0x10 per row, dest index advanced by 2) — straightforward double loop should match but may need induction-variable form
No rodata/data/bss sections in this file — no ordering or save_arrays.c concerns

Exports are called from asm/overlay_80_02235900.s, asm/unk_02096910.s, asm/overlay_80_0222ACA0.s (still asm) — no IPA breakage risk today, but the new header will be consumed by those files' future decomps
notes: Self-contained overlay 80 (Battle Frontier UI) module: creates a SysTask that animates a 2x2 blinking tilemap rect at (14,2) on BG layer 3 every 3 frames, plus two pure stat-ID remap switches used by Frontier record code (results flow into FrontierSave_GetStat / sub_02031108). Heap 0x65 throughout. SysTask priority 0x1368C. No data sections. Function order in C must be: ov80_022384D8, ov80_022384FC, ov80_02238530, ov80_0223857C, ov80_022385B0, ov80_022385C4, ov80_022385D8, ov80_02238610 (statics need forward declarations since constructors call later-defined functions).
